summary: Frontend-only final verification executed on public URL. Marker click routing remains broken: timeline/legacy/cars dot clicks stay on circuit in repeated desktop and mobile loops, while keyboard (Enter/Space) and direct programmatic navigation route correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Timeline marker dot click failed 5/5 on desktop; state remained circuit.
Timeline marker dot click failed 5/5 on mobile; state remained circuit.
Legacy marker dot click did not open legacy chapter; remained circuit.
Cars marker dot click did not open cars chapter; remained circuit.

integration_issues.issue: Required 5 consecutive opens failed on both desktop and mobile (0/5 each).

integration_issues.flow: Legacy marker open + Back to Circuit preserve overview
integration_issues.issue: Could not verify back-preserve behavior because legacy marker click never transitioned out of circuit.

action_items: Fix marker dot click routing so timeline/legacy/cars clicks deterministically open their own chapters.
Investigate why keyboard activation routes correctly but pointer click activation settles to circuit.
After fix, re-run strict loop criteria: timeline click 5/5 desktop + 5/5 mobile, plus legacy/cars click routing regression.
Re-verify Legacy -> Back to Circuit path preserves progress overview once legacy click routing works.
critical_code_review_comments: Programmatic navigation lock/settle path appears functional (window.__spatialGo to timeline/cars/legacy settles correctly).
Failure is isolated to marker dot click path despite visible marker cards and non-blocking label pointer-events.
No console/page errors and no horizontal overflow detected in tested desktop/mobile viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Observed results in rerun: desktop timeline click loops ['circuit','circuit','circuit','circuit','circuit']; mobile timeline click loops ['circuit','circuit','circuit','circuit','circuit']; keyboard timeline Enter='timeline' and Space='timeline'; marker clicks for legacy/cars also stayed at circuit. Direct __spatialGo('timeline'|'cars'|'legacy') settled correctly to target. No console errors, no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: force-open circuit overview, click marker dots (timeline/legacy/cars), wait >2.4s; viewport data-active remains 'circuit'. Keyboard activation on the same timeline marker opens timeline correctly, and direct __spatialGo settles correctly. Likely RCA: pointer-click marker path is not driving the same deterministic settle path as keyboard/programmatic route (or is being canceled/overridden before lock completion), causing click-triggered navigation to fall back to circuit state. Mitigation: instrument activate/onSelect click branch vs keydown branch, confirm onSelect invocation and token/lock lifecycle for click events, and enforce identical settle path for pointer and keyboard activations.
